description: The file defines the BasketQueryService class which implements the IBasketQueryService interface. It provides a method to asynchronously count total items in a user's basket by querying the database using Entity Framework Core.

classes.name: BasketQueryService
classes.description: A service class responsible for querying basket-related data from the database.

methods.name: CountTotalBasketItems
methods.description: Asynchronously calculates the total number of items in a user's basket directly via a database query.
